ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) pixels covering approximately 90% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized scarring, barnacle clusters, and distal edge mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-intensity region across the primary surface of both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white mottling concentrated along the distal trailing edge of the right lobe. Isolated white linear pixel paths are distributed across the central and left-ventral regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute angle and significant depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated boundary with high-frequency peaks along the entire trailing edge; right lobe exhibits deeper, more jagged pixel-amplitude variations compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve sweeping from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white and grey high-contrast pixel blobs located on the extreme lateral tips (outer margins) of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned white linear streaks; prominent diagonal marks on the left lobe and shorter scattered streaks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified accumulations (barnacles) on both fluke tips; multiple linear rake marks and localized white scarring across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical mottling pattern where the right lobe distal edge contains significantly higher white pixel density compared to the relatively solid dark left lobe distal edge.
